candidates.name: Rashida Tlaib
candidates.now: U.S. Representative for Michigan's 12th District, seeking re-election
candidates.background: Represents the Detroit/Dearborn-based 12th District since 2019; first Palestinian-American woman in Congress; a leading progressive voice.

immigration.label: Voted no on S.5, the Laken Riley Act, mandating detention of unauthorized immigrants charged with theft (House roll call 23, Jan 22 2025)

democracy.label: Voted no on H.R. 22, the SAVE Act's documentary proof-of-citizenship voter registration requirement (House roll call 102, Apr 10 2025)

climate.label: Voted no on H.J.Res. 88, opposing disapproval of California's EPA waiver for its EV/clean-car sales mandate, preserving the state's EV rule (clerk.house.gov roll 114, May 1, 2025)

safety.label: Voted no on H.R.27/S.331, the HALT Fentanyl Act permanently classifying fentanyl analogues as Schedule I with mandatory minimums (clerk.house.gov roll 33, Feb 6, 2025)

repro.label: Voted no on H.R.21, the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act (clerk.house.gov roll 27, Jan 23, 2025)

cost.label: Introduced the Stop Price Gouging in Grocery Stores Act, saying companies should not be allowed to use electronic labeling or personal information to charge higher prices and we need to ban corporate price gouging and surveillance pricing (tlaib.house.gov)

housing.label: Introduced the Housing Our Communities Act, saying we must build our way out of this crisis, and only the Federal government has the funds, and more importantly the will, to build the millions of units we need to end this crisis (tlaib.house.gov)

education.label: Introduced a bill increasing charter school oversight and accountability, saying for-profit charters have operated without accountability and our children will continue to suffer while taxpayers will be caught holding the bill for charter school waste and abuse (tlaib.house.gov)

candidates.name: Donavan McKinney
candidates.now: Democratic nominee for MI-13, Michigan State Representative
candidates.background: Michigan state representative and Democratic nominee for Michigan's 13th Congressional District, an open seat, running on a Medicare for All / Green New Deal platform.

health.label: Advocates for 'Medicare for All, which would ensure everyone in this country has healthcare' including dental, vision, mental health, and reproductive care (campaign site)

housing.label: Supports 'a national homes guarantee that would give every Michigander safe, sustainable, and permanently affordable housing' with rent control and tenant protections (campaign site)

cost.label: Proposes that 'everyone deserves money in their pocket through a universal basic income' (campaign site)

taxes.label: Calls for taxing billionaires and corporations to fund community investments, noting billionaires like Musk have 'managed to pay $0 in income taxes' (campaign site)

climate.label: Champions a 'Green New Deal transitioning to 100% clean and renewable energy' that would 'create millions of good-paying green union jobs' (campaign site)

education.label: Commits to 'put federal dollars back in our public schools' and demands 'all public colleges, universities, and trade schools should be tuition-free' (campaign site)

safety.label: Proposes 'ending cash bail, because we should not be jailing people simply because they are poor' (campaign site)

repro.label: Pledges to 'codify abortion rights at the federal level' and protect medication-abortion access nationwide (campaign site)

immigration.label: Calls for 'a pathway to citizenship for all immigrants' and opposes 'mass deportations, internment camps' (campaign site)
